note: Headers are copied in order from Shopify's sample product CSV (product_template.csv) linked from the Help Center page. The Help Center table writes two of them differently (Barcodes, Option1 LinkedTo); the downloadable template is what Shopify's own export looks like, so we follow it. Shopify says it keeps backward compatibility with older column names.
headers: Continue selling when out of stock

extraColumns.Collection: The only column you can add that doesn't break the format. Name of one collection; created if it doesn't exist. A product can be added to only one collection this way. Max 255 characters. Not included in exports.

rows.firstRow: All product fields, plus the first image URL.
rows.variantRows: Same URL handle. Leave Title, Description, Vendor and Tags blank. Fill the variant details and image URL.
rows.imageRows: One row per extra image: same URL handle, Product image URL and Image position (and alt text).
rows.simpleProduct: No variants: Option1 name Title and Option1 value Default Title, the way Shopify's own export writes it.

format.headerRow: The first line must be the column headers.
format.quote: Cells with commas, quotes or line breaks are wrapped in double quotes; quotes inside are doubled (RFC 4180).

handle: Letters, numbers and dashes only, no spaces. Defaults to the title (Black Sunglasses becomes black-sunglasses).
price: Number only, no currency symbol, like 9.99.
weight: Whole grams, no unit or decimals (4 pounds is 1814).
packed: Fill all four packed product columns or none; a partial set fails the import.
images: Each image URL must be public, start with https:// and not be password protected. File names can't end in _thumb, _small or _medium.

overwrite.selected: Values in the CSV replace the matching columns for products with the same URL handle.
overwrite.blankColumn: A blank non-required column overwrites the existing value with a blank.
overwrite.missingColumn: A column that isn't in the file keeps the existing value.
overwrite.dependent: A variant column (like SKU) without Option1 name and Option1 value deletes the variant option.
overwrite.optionsMissing: Without Option1 name and Option1 value, a new default variant is created and existing variants are deleted.
overwrite.optionValuesChanged: Changing Option1, Option2 or Option3 values deletes the variant IDs and makes new ones.

importSteps: From your Shopify admin, go to Products.
Click Add file and pick the CSV.
Optional: deselect Publish new products to all sales channels to publish to the online store only.
Leave Overwrite products with matching handles off for new products.
Click Upload and continue, read the summary, then click Import products.
